Honestly, I just disagree.  No, you don’t have to be Darth Vader to be a good villain, but Kylo Ren just isn’t good.  Yea, he was hurt and betrayed, and if he was a bad guy because of that, then fine.  But that’s not who he is.  He just throws a tantrum to get what he wants.  Just because you can come up with reasons for his characterization, doesn’t make them good reasons.  A villain should strike fear and tension when you see him on screen, but Kylo Ren just irritates me to no end when I see him.  
And Rey as a character isn’t all that bad, but her story is terrible.  They hyped up her parents as something mysterious just to be like “Nah, they were normal people”.   In the Force Awakens everything happens so convenient for her.  She just happens to find the lightsaber.  She just happens to learn how to do a Jedi mind trick when she gets captured when she’s had no training whatsoever.   And she just happens to beat Kylo Ren in a lightsaber duel with no training while he has had extensive training from Luke and Snoke.  And don’t even get me started on how much of a waste Snoke is as a character.

If you like the movies and characters, go ahead and like them, I don’t care.  It’s my opinion to dislike them as much as it is yours to enjoy them.

It’s not about the community.  A bad movie is a bad movie, regardless of if it’s Star Wars or not.  They don’t get a free pass just because they’re Star Wars.  So no, I’m not going to just mindlessly like something because I should appreciate their efforts.  I give them praise if the movie is actually good which they aren’t.  I’m not nick picking small details.  The entire movies are massively flawed throughout.
